const patch = "*** Begin Patch

+"""RoboTwin move_can_pot controller for the eai-standard/2.1 client.
+
+Run a single phase at a time with one of:
+  pregrasp, grasp, close, lift, carry, place, release, retreat
+The script reads the live measured EE poses before each action and leaves the
+inactive arm at its measured pose.
+"""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+CAN_X, CAN_Y, CAN_Z = 0.255, 0.10, 0.80
+PLACE_X, PLACE_Y, PLACE_Z = 0.17, 0.10, 0.80
+
+
+def main(phase):
+    r = Robot()
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    left = now[14:21].copy()
+    right = now[21:28].copy()
+    left_g, right_g = 1.0, 1.0
+
+    if phase == "pregrasp":
+        # EE is 12 cm behind TCP along local +x. Current wrist orientation
+        # points local +x toward the table (+world y), with jaws across x.
+        right[:3] = [CAN_X, -0.14, 0.82]
+        right_g = 1.0
+    elif phase == "grasp":
+        right[:3] = [CAN_X, CAN_Y - 0.12, CAN_Z]
+        right_g = 1.0
+    elif phase == "close":
+        right_g = 0.0
+    elif phase == "lift":
+        right[:3] = [CAN_X, CAN_Y - 0.12, 0.96]
+        right_g = 0.0
+    elif phase == "carry":
+        right[:3] = [PLACE_X, PLACE_Y - 0.12, 0.96]
+        right_g = 0.0
+    elif phase == "place":
+        right[:3] = [PLACE_X, PLACE_Y - 0.12, PLACE_Z]
+        right_g = 0.0
+    elif phase == "release":
+        right_g = 1.0
+    elif phase == "retreat":
+        right[:3] = [PLACE_X, PLACE_Y - 0.25, 0.96]
+        right_g = 1.0
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit("phase must be pregrasp, grasp, close, lift, carry, place, release, or retreat")
+
+    action = np.r_[left, left_g, right, right_g].astype(np.float32)
+    out = r.submit("ee_pose", action, video="frames", note=f"move_can_pot:{phase}")
+    Path("/app/output").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    out.save(f"/app/output/{phase}")
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "phase": phase,
+        "meta": out.meta,
+        "right_pose_after": None if out.proprio is None else out.proprio[-1, 21:28].tolist(),
+        "right_tcp_after": None if out.proprio is None else out.proprio[-1, 63:70].tolist(),
+        "right_gripper_measured": None if out.proprio is None else float(out.proprio[-1, 43]),
+        "time_left_s": out.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+    }, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "pregrasp")
